Subject: Order form insurance — initial asks

Hi Rohan,

Thanks for the draft order form. A couple quick insurance items the legal and procurement team asked us to confirm before we loop in our broker:

- Coverage minimums: your MSA lists General Liability at $1M / $2M aggregate and Cyber at $1M. Hyperion's standard requires GL at $2M / $4M and Cyber at $2M; we're trying to understand if you can accept the higher minimums or provide a carve for scope.
- Additional insured: procurement asked for the customer (Hyperion Analytics) to be named as Additional Insured on the General Liability, and to receive an endorsement.
- COI delivery: they want a Certificate of Insurance (COI) showing the endorsement to be delivered prior to go-live, plus a broker contact for overnight issuance if vendor changes.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can:
1) Accept higher GL/Cyber minimums, or
2) Provide an endorsement + a temporary COI with an LOA approach while underwriting finalizes changes?

If you prefer, you can loop Kim or Aditya from your side for the broker coordination.

Thanks,
Jordan (on behalf of Hyperion procurement)
Jordan Lee

Subject: Re: Order form insurance — initial asks

Thanks Jordan — appreciate the clear list. Quick notes from our side:

- Coverage: Our standard MSA (and carrier program) is GL 1/2 and Cyber 1M. We can request GL/Cyber limit increases with our carrier but that typically adds time (~2–4 weeks) and may impact premium.
- Endorsement/Additional insured: We do provide Additional Insured endorsements for customers on primary GL where legally required; semantics matter (e.g., which entities and whether subcontractors are included).
- Interim COI: We can provide a COI that lists Hyperion as Additional Insured along with an endorsement stub (carrier approval pending) as a temporary remedy while the carrier issues full endorsement.

Next steps I propose:
- Kim (cc) will own the broker ask and confirm whether the carrier will consent to GL 2/4 or provide an LOA + endorsement timeline.
- Aditya (cc) — can you put together a 1-page note for Hyperion legal explaining the interim COI + endorsement process and expected timelines if we request increased limits?

If that works, Jordan, we'll follow up with a broker contact and either: (A) formal endorsement template + ETA, or (B) LOA + temporary COI for go-live.

Best,
Rohan Mehta
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
